Antes de guardar una propuesta (también: Before a proposal is stored (including those from agents over MCP) or a document is indexed, it is checked for credentials: cloud keys, tokens, private keys, JWTs, Authorization headers and passwords in URLs. A random value assigned to «password», «token» or «secret» counts as possible and is only flagged. Neither the audit log nor notifications store the value.
El análisis pasa el detector por las pro: The scan runs the detector over the brain's proposals and indexed documents, with the saved exceptions, without changing anything. Use it to see hits and false positives before changing the policy. What is already in the graph is not scanned.
